source_dataset: ACTIVSg2000-derived representative days of the 2028 scenario year

submission_2.base_load: representative base load plus the hourly net grid withdrawal of every Submission 1 site of every team (site load served minus its private generation and battery net discharge)
submission_2.submission_1_sites: fixed base load; not re-evaluated, re-scored, re-projected or re-dispatched
submission_2.csv_contents: new sites only; a site_id may not repeat one of the same team's Submission 1 site_ids
submission_2.scoring: Submission 1 sites keep their Submission 1 ten-year value

final_score: week-2 submission 1 + week-2 submission 2 + week-3 submission 1 + week-3 submission 2

required_before_release: all 120 representative periods pass single-period DCOPF validation
official eight-team benchmark completes for a Submission 1 and a Submission 2 with carried base load
